flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

opportunities.point: Management targets a bare minimum revenue growth of 20% for the upcoming period while aiming for higher growth.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "It should be. We are targeting a little higher as well. But at a bare minimum, yes, 20% is quite achievable, but we are targeting for higher growth." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: The company acquired Fortira Inc., USA in April 2025.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Acquired Fortira Inc., USA in April 2025, significantly strengthening Canarys' presence in the North American technology services market." (concall ppt - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: The strategic acquisition of Fortira, a U.S.-based AI, data, digital engineering, and IT consulting firm, was completed in April 2025 for a 51% stake.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Completed this acquisition in April 2025 for a 51% stake, underscored our transition from a local solutions company to a global, active, innovation-driven technology enterprise." (concall transcript - 2025-12-01)

opportunities.point: Commissioned capacity should start contributing to revenue.
opportunities.evidence: CWIP 12 Cr -> 0 Cr (-100%) as of Sep 2026

opportunities.point: The price embeds less growth than the company has actually delivered.
opportunities.evidence: Reverse DCF implies -0.46% earnings growth vs 46% delivered over 5 years

opportunities.point: P/B is cheaper than the sector median.
The company stated that the project pipeline is strong with multiple active opportunities.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Pipeline is pretty strong. We are working on multiple project opportunities." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: Management stated that AI is a market disruption and that customers constantly ask if the company has an AI practice.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "AI, it is a disruption happening in the market and any new customer the first thing they ask is do you have AI practice and if yes, what kind of practice, right?" (concall transcript - 2025-12-01)

opportunities.point: The total order book stands at approximately INR441 crores.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Our order book stands at approximately INR441 crores, giving us healthy revenue visibility for the years ahead." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: Technology Solutions contributes INR206 crores to the order book, Fortira adds INR207 crores, and Water Resource Management contributes INR28 crores.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Technology Solutions contributes INR206 crores, nearly doubling from INR105 crores in FY '25. Fortira adds INR207 crores and Water Resource Management contributes INR28 crores." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: Margin correction for Fortira to build traction and change margins will take 12 to 18 months.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "So it would take at least 12 to 18 months for us to really build the traction and change the margins." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01) [12 to 18 months]

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
Peers earn a better ROCE - the competitive position looks weaker.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Growth in profit after tax was impacted by a onetime exceptional item related to the implementation of labour code provisions.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Profit after tax stood at INR10 crores. Growth here was affected by a onetime exceptional item relating to the implementation of labour code provisions." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

threats.point: Standalone PAT growth was impacted by a one-time exceptional loss related to labor code provisions.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "However, PAT growth was affected by a one-time exceptional loss related to the implementation of labour code provisions." (concall ppt - 2026-07-01)

threats.point: Water resource management projects involve longer payment cycles, leading the company to take a more focused approach.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "These projects have strengthened our expertise, but given longer payment cycles, we now take a more focused approach choosing opportunities that offer speed, scale, and better commercial outcomes." (concall transcript - 2025-12-01)

threats.point: Small size brings liquidity and volatility risk.
Historically weak quarters (Mar, Sep) are still in the cycle.

swot.verdict: Strengths dominate the evidence (S30/W24/O28/T17), led by 'Capital efficiency is high - the business earns well above a normal cost of capital', with 69 points of weight still sitting on the weakness, opportunity and threat side.
